summary: Kerb with cars parked along it, backing onto bush; dormitories 29 m away.
reasons: Cars already park along this kerb

best_section.where: Sir William MacGregor Drive south kerb, among the parked cars past the bend

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto dense bush; dormitories 29-41 m away on the far side of the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Cars parked along the kerb show there is room to stop; dirt verge beside it.
drivers.traffic: Campus access road; quiet-ish, parked cars shield the van from the lane.
drivers.convention: Several cars parked in a row, so a van will not stand out.

flags: Sign: No Stopping Any Time at the start of the line (2 m from kerb line)
Low-lying: about 8 m elevation, Brisbane River 178 m away
sun_shade: Heavy tree shade, mostly from the bush on the south side; sun from the north at midday is partly blocked.
cannot_judge: Whether the No Stopping sign covers the parked section
